title: Bare bones almost powerless cordless vacuum; picks up light dust and wisps of hair only
text:
Bare bones almost powerless cordless vacuum; picks up light dust and wisps of hair only. I am very disappointed in this cordless vacuum because it lacks any “pick-me-up.” I was only able to pick up tiny wisps of cat hair and dust and was barely able to pick up any cat litter sprinkled throughout the carpet or bare floor. If I uncoupled the hand vac from the floor head, then it had a bit more suction but still not enough. However, there is no way I am vacuuming a floor on my hands and knees with a hand vac even if the suction were great. This vacuum is too weak to be useful to me.

FACTS:

- Assembly of the four parts (floor head, hand vac, extension pole, top curved handle) is required.

- The fifth part is the charging cord that plugs into the hand vac portion of the vacuum.

- The floor head has no beater bar (meaning no rotating brush).

- There is no charging light on the vacuum or the charging cord.

- A charge of 16 hours before first use is needed and it is safe to leave on the charger indefinitely.

- The curved handle and pole are not removable once assembled; however, rest of vacuum comes apart for configuring into the various combinations.

- This is a 4-in-1 vacuum meaning there are four vacuum component combinations:
1) with floor head and hand vac attached (short handle)
2) with just the hand vac (meaning no floor head or pole handle)
3) with just the hand vac and long pole handle
4) with floor head and long handle attached to the hand vac – note that this is the typical upright full vacuum.

LIKES:

- Self-standing design with ability to hang from handle hole as well. There is also a wall fitting available for purchase according to the instructions in case one wants to hang the vacuum on the wall.

- Dust bowl and filter are easy to empty and wash.

- Swivel steering.

- "Ease of glide" along my bare floor.

- Two-year limited warranty

- Cordless with lithium ion battery (wall charger cord included)

DISLIKES in order of importance to me:

- There is limited suction, especially when fully assembled as an upright vacuum.

- The vacuum feels cheap like the plastic will break after a while.

- The floor head and hand vac are difficult to couple and uncouple.

- There is no charging light.

- The assembly instructions are not clear when it comes which way to line up the holes in the handle.

In summary, this is truly a bare bones vacuum. To get four stars, it would have to be able to pick up the tiny granules of cat litter sprinkled throughout my floor and carpet. To get five stars it would also have to feel sturdier than it currently feels.
